references.text: The laws concerning impurity from contact with a dead body, which explain why these men were unclean.
The command to send unclean persons out of the camp, including those made unclean by contact with the dead.
The Nazirite laws regarding impurity from contact with the dead, showing the seriousness of such defilement.
Detailed rules about impurity from touching a dead person and the cleansing process.
Prohibition against eating the peace offering while unclean, illustrating the consequences of impurity during holy meals.
The original Passover regulations establishing who may participate in the Passover meal.
God's response to the issue of impurity at Passover, providing for a second Passover.
